items.change: Renamed the Next.js middleware file to proxy.ts and renamed the exported function from middleware to proxy.
Enabled Turbopack's development filesystem cache and the React compiler.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 support for turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev and reactCompiler.
Turbopack becoming the default development bundler in Next.js 16.
Next.js 16 generating development route types under .next/dev/types.

items.change: Reworked the Next ESLint configuration to register the plugin explicitly and spread its recommended rules instead of extending next.flatConfig.recommended.
items.responds_to: The changed Next ESLint plugin configuration API in Next.js 16.

items.change: Introduced a client-side NextLink wrapper and changed website imports from next/link to that wrapper.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 link usage issues referenced by issues 85604 and 85470.

items.change: Wrapped the global-search contents in React Activity, switching between visible and hidden modes based on whether the search is open.
items.responds_to: The React 19 Activity API adopted with the Next.js 16 upgrade.

items.change: Made Header asynchronous, awaited headers(), detected the user agent server-side, and passed the resulting platform flag into the search components instead of detecting it in an effect.
Added a production-build input and workflow secret for NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
items.responds_to: Next.js server-action encryption requiring a stable encryption key for production builds.

items.change: Added a custom LRU cache handler and configured Next.js to use it with cacheMaxMemorySize set to zero.
Delayed assigning the iframe src until after mount so the iframe load handler runs on the initial render, and tracked its height separately.
items.responds_to: The Next.js iframe initial-render/onLoad behavior documented in issue 69736.

items.change: Changed the NextLink wrapper to default prefetch to false and removed explicit prefetch={false} props from its consumers.
items.responds_to: Changed Next.js Link prefetch behavior and the resulting desire to avoid prefetching all routes.

items.change: Reverted the default-prefetch=false wrapper and restored explicit prefetch={false} on selected links.
items.responds_to: The prior Next.js Link prefetch change caused some links to stop working.
